output.answer_markdown: The passages do not support a Q2 2023 spin-off. They only describe past transactions: the spin-off of the former Upjohn Business, completed in the fourth quarter of 2020 [1][3], and the sale of Meridian in Q4 2021 [1]. As of FY2022, Pfizer managed two operating segments, Biopharma and PC1 [1][4]. None of the passages mentions a planned or pending spin-off of a large business segment. No Q2 2023 filing is provided, so the passages cannot confirm the status as of that date.
